title: International Geophysical Year and the Antarctic no-fly zone

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that during the International Geophysical Year, a worldwide science effort around 1956 to 1957, Antarctica became a no-fly zone. He raises it as part of a larger idea he is building, suggesting the closing of the continent's skies may hide something worth asking about.
